cases.name: Valerie Reyes
cases.about: "Reyes was a 2012 graduate of New Rochelle High School. She worked at Barnes & Noble at the Vernon Hills Shopping Center in Eastchester since the store opened more than two years ago. Reyes is survived by her mother, father, and three brothers. Her mother, Norma Sanchez, said last week that her daughter had a creative streak and yearned to be a tattoo artist like her brother." https://www.lohud.com/story/news/local/westchester/new-rochelle/2019/02/13/family-friends-mourn-valerie-reyes-funeral/2856911002/
cases.narrative: On 2/5/2019, her body was found. She suffocated but it is unclear if it was before or after she was put in the suitcase. There were signs of head trauma with bruising around her face and a large hematoma to her forehead. Her body was found stuffed in a red suitcase on the side of a road with her hands, knees and feet bound and packing tape over her mouth.
